findings.summary: The tax label "(84% מהפסד)" reads like a tax on a loss, which makes it hard to understand what the cost figure means.
The monthly deposit slider shows 800 while the field shows 750, so it is unclear which amount the result uses.
The result assumes the dollar doesn't move against the shekel, and that assumption isn't explained simply. This is a wish for more explanation.
Part of the input row moved sideways after the first field was edited. This is a small layout shift, not the result cards jumping because a note appears and disappears.
The inflation assumption is behind a button instead of showing as a number on the main screen. This is about where it is shown, not a button that does nothing.
